@graph.headline: Help Scout vs Zendesk: Features and Pricing
@graph.description: Compare Help Scout vs Zendesk on monthly cost, ticketing, shared inbox, AI, knowledge base, automation and migration to choose the right support platform.

mainEntity.name: Is Help Scout cheaper than Zendesk?

acceptedAnswer.text: The monthly entry rates shown November 20, 2026 are both US$25 per seat for Help Scout Standard and Zendesk Support Team. Zendesk Suite Team is US$69 monthly, while Help Scout Plus is US$45 monthly.

mainEntity.name: Does Zendesk have a free plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zendesk's public pricing page checked November 20, 2026 advertises a free trial and lists paid Support and Suite plans. It does not show a permanent free support plan.

mainEntity.name: Does Help Scout include a knowledge base?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Help Scout calls its knowledge base Docs. The plan page lists one site on Free, two on Standard, three on Plus and five on Pro. Free also lists ten articles.

mainEntity.name: Can I move Zendesk tickets into Help Scout?

acceptedAnswer.text: Help Scout's Import2 guide lists Zendesk as a supported source. The standard import does not include every user, Inbox setting, article or automation, so test a sample.
Zendesk's current pricing page lists AI Agents on Suite Team and higher Suite plans. Check the plan comparison and quote for exact features and usage charges.

mainEntity.name: Which tool is better for a small support team?

acceptedAnswer.text: Help Scout is a sensible starting point for a shared Inbox and Docs. Zendesk Support Team is worth comparing when the team needs ticket routing and reporting.
